description: QNEAT3 (QGIS Network Analysis Toolbox 3) is a QGIS plugin that adds network analysis algorithms to the QGIS Processing Toolbox, designed to fit QGIS conventions, not stand alone. Coverage: generic, for any line network loaded in QGIS. Implemented algorithms include Dijkstra shortest paths between two points chosen in the QGIS interface, origin-destination matrices between all points of a layer, and isochrone (iso-area) calculations as point clouds, interpolated rasters, contours and polygons. Format and access: plugin source on GitHub for installation into QGIS. Licence and cost: GPL-3.0, free. Caveats: static shortest-path analysis only, with no traffic assignment or congestion; the maintenance status was not checked. It supports accessibility and emergency response analyses, such as service areas of fire stations or hospitals before and after link closures. It relates to the Networks QGIS plugin and the Space Syntax Toolkit in the catalogue.
